title: Trade-In Credit on Termination Refunds
content:
# Trade-In Credit on Termination Refunds

Sales-desk incentive terms, Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda. A holder whose Kessler GAP waiver is terminated after the lienholder reports the loan paid off or refinanced away receives a trade-in credit on the termination refund when the holder's replacement purchase carries a trade-in.

**The replacement purchase.** It is the holder's most recently signed group purchase deal under the Vehicle Purchase Agreements: the deal whose vehicle price was charged last (of two charged on the same day, the one recorded first), where that deal stands in contracted status. Where the latest such deal stands in any other status there is no replacement purchase. Its trade-in is its trade-in allowance, and it carries a trade-in when that allowance is above 0.00.

**The credit.**

- Where the replacement purchase carries a trade-in and is a New Vehicle Retail Purchase or a New Vehicle Factory Order Purchase, 50.00 is added to the termination refund.
- Where it carries a trade-in and is a Used Vehicle Retail Purchase, a Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Purchase or a Value Line Used Vehicle Purchase, 25.00 is added.
- In every other case no trade-in credit is added.

The credit is added to the refund after the unused-share amount has been rounded half up to the cent.

**Q&A (hypothetical situations).**

*The holder's latest deal is a contracted New Vehicle Factory Order Purchase with a trade-in allowance of 4,150.00.* The credit is 50.00.

*The latest deal is a contracted Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Purchase with a trade-in allowance of 0.00.* No trade-in, no credit.

*The latest deal carried a trade-in but has since been delivered.* It no longer stands in contracted status, so there is no replacement purchase and no credit.

*The latest deal is a contracted Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement with a trade-in.* Not one of the listed deal types: no credit.
